privacy_content: UNIONE does not collect any sensitive personal data. Your transactions are secured locally.
about_zoli_desc: UNIONE is an application designed to simplify access to USSD codes of mobile operators in Benin (MTN, MOOV, Celtiis). No need to memorize or search for codes — everything is grouped in one place, organized and accessible in seconds.
about_dev_desc: I am Ulrich IDOHOU, a Flutter developer based in Abomey-Calavi, Benin. Passionate about creating useful and accessible tools for African daily life, I develop applications focused on the local user experience.
favorites_desc: This feature will allow you to save your favorite USSD codes to access them even faster. It will be available in a future update.
security_desc:
UNIONE integrates advanced security measures to protect your transactions:

• Automatic lock after 5 minutes of inactivity or 30 seconds in the background.
• Automatic hiding of app content in the app switcher to avoid prying eyes.
• All your history data is stored locally and encrypted.
terms_desc:
By using UNIONE, you agree to the following conditions:

• UNIONE is an assistant that facilitates entering USSD codes but is not affiliated with mobile operators.
• You are responsible for validating the entered amounts and numbers before sending.
• The application is provided 'as is' without warranty regarding code modifications by operators.
share_desc: Share UNIONE with your friends to simplify their access to USSD codes.
clear_history_desc: This action is irreversible. All your local data will be deleted.
auth_reason: Please authenticate to validate the transaction
